CHAPTER 1

THE LONG SLEEP

MUTATED SNAKE

GUIDE▾

YOU DIED

The snake got you. Tips: jump over the ground shockwaves, dodge the venom (watch for the red circles), shoot from range, and punch it while it is stunned after a charge.

CHAPTER 1 COMPLETE

You dissolved the barricade with real chemistry. WHAT YOU LEARNED: metal erodes when it is oxidized, meaning its atoms lose electrons and dissolve as ions. Hydrochloric acid does this (Fe + 2HCl gives FeCl2 + H2), and hydrogen peroxide, an oxidizer, speeds it up. Chloride ions from salt slip through the metal’s oxide skin, and salt pulls water out of plant cells by osmosis. pH measures acid strength on a scale where each step is 10 times different. Always add acid TO water, stir with glass, wear goggles and gloves, and remember that a base such as baking soda neutralizes an acid. You went down 10 floors of stairs, found venom and weapon parts in the staff storage, built a Venom Blaster, melted the sealed door, and took down the giant mutated snake in the Exit Lab. Outside, the city was swallowed by nature, and a paper in the wind told you the truth: the animals turned on humanity, and the people left Earth for Mars. You are alone. But what created the mutants?

CHAPTER 2

ON FOOT

END OF CHAPTER 2

You wired a dying radio ten times over, and a looping broadcast told you the way: west, to the Ridge Tower. You outran a burning road full of mutated animals, lost the signal again, and built your own bed in the old forest. For one night you dreamed of sunshine, the sea and people… then you woke up alone, and desperately thirsty. A crumpled note pointed to the Ridge Tower. You bridged a raging river with your own hands, searched crashed cargo containers, and turned river water into safe water just before the dam gave way. At the old bridge port the last ship was about to leave: you built a crowbar from scrap, pried the wire off the gate, and boarded just in time. Next stop: the Ridge Tower.

THIS IS THE END OF CHAPTER 2 FOR NOW. MORE IN A FUTURE UPDATE.
